parameters.query: SELECT address, clinic_hours, obras_sociales, welcome_text FROM clinic_settings WHERE id = 1 LIMIT 1;
SELECT id, name FROM doctors WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order, name;

SELECT d.name AS doctor_name, da.day, da.start_time, da.end_time
FROM doctor_availability da
JOIN doctors d ON d.id = da.doctor_id
WHERE da.week_start = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)
  AND da.is_unavailable = 0
  AND d.active = 1
ORDER BY d.sort_order, da.day;
